title: Kinetra
features: Onboarding with a primary goal pick (build strength, lose weight, run further, stay active) and weekly target
Today dashboard: weekly activity ring, streak, today's planned workout, quick log
Workout library with plans and routines (strength, cardio, mobility) and filters
Workout detail with exercise list, sets x reps, estimated time and Start
Live exercise logging: log sets, reps and weight per exercise, rest timer, mark set done
Exercise picker with search and muscle-group filters to add an exercise
Workout summary after finishing: duration, volume, sets, personal records
Goal tracking: list of goals with progress bars and deadlines
Create a goal: type, target value, deadline, weekly reminder
Progress charts: weekly volume, workouts per week, body weight trend, personal records
Weekly progress report: summary stats, goal progress, highlights, consistency
Profile with units, reminders, connected devices (simulated) and data export (simulated)

bottomTabBar.note: Flat white bar, 1px top hairline border, no gradient. Active tab: icon + label in text.primary ink with a small neon accent pill (accent #CCFF00) behind the icon; inactive: text.secondary.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Header on tab screens: screen title on the left in display style (Instrument Serif), round avatar or icon button on the right.
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: pill, 56px tall, accent neon #CCFF00 fill with ink #1C1F0C label (pressed accentPressed, disabled 40% opacity). Dark button variant: ink fill with white label. Secondary button: pill, white with 1.5px borderStrong border, ink label. Text input: 12px radius, 52px, white, borderStrong border, focus = 2px accentFill ring, error = danger border + 13px helper. Card: white, 20px radius, soft shadow. Chip: pill, 32px, accentTint fill with accentFill text, 13px; selected chip = ink fill with neon text. Progress bar: 8px pill track surfaceAlt, fill accentFill.

type.scaleRule: Use only the 5 declared sizes (display, title, body, label, caption).

designSystem.a11y: neon accent carries ink labels only; white labels on accentFill or ink only; text on gradients >= 4.5:1; tap targets >= 44pt
